title: FilesRevealResult
description: Result of the files.reveal JSON-RPC method: the path was revealed in the platform's file manager (Finder/Explorer). Local bindings only — the backend refuses a remote binding rather than silently doing nothing, because a UI-only guard is one bug away from being no guard (§5.2). An empty result is still a contract: additionalProperties: false on an empty shape is what makes 'returns nothing' enforceable.
